items.title: 8.1.1 Macroscopic events (nazar aane wale events) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.1.1, printed page 168.

blocks.title: Macroscopic events
blocks.text: Macroscopic events (nazar aane wale events) woh tabdeeliyan hain jo nangi aankh se dekhi ja sakti hain, aur in ke liye alag alag particles ya molecules ko dekhne ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

Colour (rang) badalna, heat ka nikalna ya absorb (jazb) hona, precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) banna, gas nikalna, volume ya pressure badalna, aur chemical reaction mein kisi substance ki composition (banawat) badalna: yeh sab macroscopic properties ki misalein hain.

blocks.prompt: Do colourless (be-rang) solutions milane par test tube garam ho jati hai aur peela solid neeche baith jata hai. Kaun se macroscopic events nazar aaye?
blocks.explanation: Heat ka nikalna (tube garam hui), rang badalna (colourless se peela) aur precipitate banna (solid neeche baitha). Teenon aankh se nazar aate hain; in ke peeche ions aur molecules ko dekhne ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Macroscopic events nangi aankh se nazar aate hain: rang, heat, precipitate, gas, volume ya pressure, composition ki tabdeeli.
